records.subject: Health
records.title: Government Health Expenditure, Annual
records.footnote: Data are based on the financial year (FY), which begins in April of the current year and ends in March of the following year. Data up to FY2024 are actual figures. Data for FY2025 are revised estimates. Data for FY2026 are budgeted estimates. Actual figures are the finalised, audited financial position of the Government. A revised estimate refers to updates to a previously published estimate for a given Financial Year.

row.footnote: Includes expenditure such as government subventions to restructured hospitals and other subsidised institutions, grants to statutory boards such as Health Promotion Board and Health Sciences Authority, as well as expenditure by healthcare-related endowment/trust funds.  It excludes healthcare expenditure from private sources.  With effect from FY 2008, administrative expenses of healthcare-related funds were added to Government Health Expenditure.  With effect from FY 2011, changes were made to the calculation of healthcare-related fund expenditure.

row.rowText: Proportion Of Government Expenditure On Health To GDP
row.footnote: 'Government Expenditure on Health' includes expenditure from endowment funds and excludes government transfers.
